get.description:
List cases in a project space, or fetch a single case by identifier. Cases track structured data about a person, place or thing, collected and updated by CommCare mobile or web app forms.

Requires the `edit_data` permission.

parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return. Use 0 to request all records.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of records to skip.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Response format.
parameters.name: format

parameters.description: Field to sort by. Prefix with "-" to reverse.
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.description: User or group UUID. Returns all cases owned by that entity (should not be used together with user_id).
parameters.name: owner_id

parameters.description: User UUID. Returns all cases last modified by that user.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Return only cases matching this case type.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Filter by case status: true for closed cases, false for open cases. Omit to return both.
parameters.name: closed

parameters.description: Only return cases that have had data modified on or after this date (and time). Recommended for pagination, as it handles edge cases better than server_date_modified.
parameters.name: indexed_on_start

parameters.description: Only return cases that have had data modified on or before this date (and time).
parameters.name: indexed_on_end

parameters.description: Only return cases modified on or after this date (phone-reported date). Defaults to the first submission date.
parameters.name: date_modified_start

parameters.description: Only return cases modified on or before this date (phone-reported date). Defaults to the current date.
parameters.name: date_modified_end

parameters.description: Only return cases modified on or after this date (server date). Defaults to the first submission date.
parameters.name: server_date_modified_start

parameters.description: Only return cases modified on or before this date (server date). Defaults to the current date.
parameters.name: server_date_modified_end

parameters.description: Filter cases by case name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Filter cases by the case's external_id property.
parameters.name: external_id

parameters.description: When true, include the full child case objects in the "child_cases" field.
parameters.name: child_cases__full

parameters.description: When true, include the full parent case objects in the "parent_cases" field.
parameters.name: parent_cases__full

parameters.description: When true, include the full form objects in the "xforms_by_name" field.
parameters.name: xforms_by_name__full

parameters.description: When true, include the full form objects in the "xforms_by_xmlns" field.
parameters.name: xforms_by_xmlns__full

properties.languages: python java javascript c php erlang love

child_cases.description: Child cases of this case, keyed by index identifier. Returned only when child_cases__full=true is passed.

closed_by.description: UUID of the user who closed the case, or null if the case is open.

date_closed.description: Date and time the case was closed, or null if the case is open.

date_modified.description: Date and time the case was last modified, as reported by the submitting phone.

domain.description: Domain (project space) that owns the case.

indexed_on.description: Date and time the case was indexed into Elasticsearch. Useful for pagination since it always increases, unlike phone-reported dates.

indices.description: References to other cases linked to this case, keyed by index identifier, each giving the related case_type and case_id.

opened_by.description: UUID of the user who opened the case.

parent_cases.description: Parent cases of this case, keyed by index identifier. Returned only when parent_cases__full=true is passed.

properties.description: Case property values, including special predefined properties (case_name, case_type, external_id, owner_id, date_opened) and any user-defined dynamic properties.

resource_uri.description: URI of this record in the API.

server_date_modified.description: Date and time the case was last modified on the server.

server_date_opened.description: Date and time the case was opened on the server.

user_id.description: UUID of the user that last modified the case.

xform_ids.description: UUIDs of the forms that have updated this case.

xforms_by_name.description: Forms that have updated this case, grouped by form name. Returned only when xforms_by_name__full=true is passed.

xforms_by_xmlns.description: Forms that have updated this case, grouped by form XMLNS. Returned only when xforms_by_xmlns__full=true is passed.

parameters.description: The project space (domain) name.
parameters.name: domain
